comment_rover_id: rover_id is per-rover and lives in the untracked picar-cfg.local.json (created by install.sh) so it survives git pulls. Defaults to 1 if that file is absent.
comment_fleetManagerUrl: 'auto' = discover the Fleet Manager on the LAN (OS-agnostic, no IP/hostname needed). Or set an explicit http://host:port. Empty disables.
comment_telemetry: Battery/power come from the flight controller (SYS_STATUS, POWER_STATUS). batteryWarnLevel is a remaining-percentage threshold and only works if BATT_CAPACITY is set on the flight controller - it reports 0 when unset, which is why batteryWarnVolts exists as a voltage threshold that always works. Set batteryWarnVolts for your pack (e.g. 3.5V x cells).
comment1: pigpion is for the native picpio lib in C
comment2: mavproxy is backend for mavproxy to talk w/ pixhawk, push pwm there
comment_drivetrain: drivetrain_settle_ms: delay between the neutral+DISARM of a gear/diff change and actually moving the actuator, so a coasting vehicle slows first. Not a confirmed stop - this vehicle has no wheel encoder and GPS is disabled.
comment_latency: Video latency is bounded by DROPPING stale frames rather than queueing them. h264_drop_delta_bytes: per-client WebSocket backlog above which delta frames are dropped (keyframes still sent so the client can resync). h264_drop_all_bytes: hard backlog above which everything is dropped. mjpeg_drop_bytes: socket backlog above which an MJPEG frame is skipped.
